issues: Backup passphrase UI only enforces a minimum length; the task requires a strong passphrase (>=8 characters and at least three of the four character classes). This is a missing security requirement and could allow trivially guessable backups. Add validation for uppercase, lowercase, digit, and symbol characters and disable the backup button until the policy is met.

The web fallback does not set a Content‑Security‑Policy header/meta tag, leaving the optional web build vulnerable to injection attacks. Add a CSP meta tag (or configure the server) to restrict sources to 'self'.
feedback: All Jest acceptance tests and static validation checks passed, but the implementation still misses important security requirements from the specification and the security review. Adding passphrase complexity validation and a CSP header resolves the high‑level issues before the app can be considered complete.
